subject: Maths
topic: Introduction to Graphs — Line and Bar

questions.q: For the linear relation y = 2x, what is the value of y when x = 7?
questions.explanation: The relation y = 2x means every y-coordinate is twice its corresponding x-coordinate. Substituting x = 7 gives y = 2 x 7. Therefore y = 14, and the point (7,14) lies on the same straight-line graph.

questions.q: The perimeter P of a square is graphed against its side length s using the values 1,2,3,4,5 and 4,8,12,16,20. Which additional point lies on the same linear graph?
questions.explanation: The table follows the rule P = 4s. For s = 6, the corresponding perimeter is 4 x 6 = 24. Hence (6,24) continues the same linear relationship.

questions.q: Points A(1,2), B(4,2) and C(1,4) are three vertices of an axis-aligned rectangle. What is the fourth vertex?
questions.explanation: A and B have the same y-coordinate, so AB is horizontal, while A and C have the same x-coordinate, so AC is vertical. The missing corner must combine B's x-coordinate 4 with C's y-coordinate 4. Therefore the fourth vertex is (4,4).

questions.q: For the relation p = 2q, which pair correctly gives p when q = 3 and q when p = 8?
questions.explanation: When q = 3, p = 2 x 3 = 6. When p = 8, the equation 8 = 2q gives q = 4. Thus the required pair is p = 6 and q = 4.
